title: gateway.connection-put request
description: Create or replace a connection. Takes no secret: the app sets the returned slot with `orbit plugin secret set gateway <slot>`.

base_url.description: https, or plain http to a loopback address. For secret_path, the origin only (https://host/).

scheme.description: bearer, basic, header, none, secret_path (the slot holds the path and query) or oauth2_device (the slot holds a refresh token).

header.description: The header the secret is sent in (scheme header).

username.description: The user name (scheme basic); the slot holds the password.

scopes.description: oauth2_device: the scopes to request (at least one).

methods.description: Methods that run directly: GET and HEAD only. If omitted, defaults to [GET]; an empty list permits no direct methods.

drafts.description: Write methods an agent may draft for approval: POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.

idempotency_header.description: A header the API reads an idempotency key from; a sent draft carries its draft id in it.
